author: sondotjpg
body:
• IGN: sondotjpg
  • Reason/Time: Hacked Client, Aimbot, Team Griefing/Perm
  • Reason I should be unbanned:  For the Aimbot, I was downloading Primal Carnage through Steam, watching YouTube, Skyping 5 of my friends, and playing Nebula. Obviously, my lag is going to be off the charts. For the Team Griefing, yesterday I was playing some Nebula when a kid on my team spleefed me. I did nothing but kill the people he was going to kill, and he said I was annoying him. Then, he said that I spleefed him and that he did nothing, which wasnt true. And if the Team Griefing was the one to Slimeblock03, we were in a Skype call and were just messing around. And, I just joined the server yesterday. No way in heck I'm going to use a Hacked Client on my new favorite pvp Server.
